Hi Irene,

Hope you’re well. Oakridge is doing a standard vendor security review for a new credit analytics integration. As part of our diligence we need to review your SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent 12-month period.

Because the report contains sensitive control details, we require a signed mutual NDA before we can accept it. Could you:

- Share your standard mutual NDA (or confirm you can countersign ours)
- Confirm the audit window for the SOC 2 Type II report you’ll share
- Provide an anticipated turnaround (we’re hoping to review by end of next week)

I’ve attached a short questionnaire (SOC2_Request_Form.xlsx) that our security team uses to track items.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,

Irene / team — thanks for the ping. I reviewed Oakridge’s ask and your proposed redlines. Summary:

- I ran our standard mutual NDA (attached: NDA_Executed_Oakridge_20271018.pdf) through a quick counter-sign. I kept the limited distribution and mutual confidentiality language; removed a clause that gave open-ended subcontractor disclosure rights.
- I added a short audit evidence handling note (Section 4) that requires access via secure, time-limited link or in-person review; we will not attach the full Type II PDF over unencrypted email.
- On timing: we can countersign today; once countersigned we can provide a secure download link (S3 with pre-signed URL) or schedule a controlled review session.

Audit period question: Michael’s note didn’t specify the audit window Oakridge needs. Our most recent Type II covers 2026-09-01 through 2027-08-31. If Oakridge requires coverage through a later date, we should offer a bridge letter confirming controls remained unchanged since the report period, and indicate when the next Type II will be available. Laura, can you confirm whether we should proactively offer a bridge letter or wait for Oakridge to request it?

Attached: NDA_Executed_Oakridge_20271018.pdf (executed, scanned), redlines are tracked in NDA_Redline_v3.pdf.

Michael — thanks for the quick turn. Per legal, attached is the executed mutual NDA (NDA_Executed_Oakridge_20271018.pdf). We can proceed once you countersign on your side or acknowledge receipt if your signature is already present.

Delivery options (pick one):
1) Secure pre-signed S3 download (recommended): we will generate a time-limited link to the Type II PDF and provide a one-time passcode. Link will be logged and access-limited.
2) Controlled review session: 30–45 minute screen-share where we walk through the report; no files transferred.
3) In-person or verified virtual audit (if your compliance team needs to inspect evidence).

Our audit period: 2026-09-01 through 2027-08-31. If you require coverage beyond that window, we can provide a standard bridge letter confirming no material control changes and summarizing interim control checks. Let us know which you prefer and who will countersign on your side.

Next steps:
- Please confirm the signer for the NDA on Oakridge’s side or return an executed copy.
- Tell us preferred delivery option and target review date.
